items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: Wilford had got a job back in Gentilly. It was in a barn, cow barn. And he asked if I wanted to play the job.

ctx.x: Yeah, I never knew him. Well, we went up to Wilford's house, Wilford Ledet. He was a drummer. Well, he had a set of drums up there. Well, I wasn't worried about no drum. We was just sitting down and having a good time. And I started to pat my foot and Walter said, you ever played drums before? I said, yeah. I said, why, yeah? He said, well, I noticed you're keeping good time with your foot. I said, yeah, I used to play quite a while. And so Wilford set up his drums and it was him. And I and the guitar. So during…
Who else was in the band?
